result.delivery: Validate structured data before using the host rendering channel. Validation does not itself display a component.
result.semantics: Only fields inside dataFacts are program-computed; summary and fullDataExplanation are echoed model prose, never independently verified. Do not attribute an extra calculation to the program if it is absent from dataFacts. zeroFillIllustration.directionRelativeToObservedMean compares a hypothetical zero-filled mean to the observed-data mean only: signed values can make it higher, lower or the same. The observed sum and zeroFillIllustration.sum cover their named counts; zero-fill leaves a finite observed subtotal unchanged. Equal statistics do not erase missingness. These comparisons do not establish bias relative to unknown complete-data means or sums. A zero fill can leave the numeric mean unchanged; do not say every imputation changes it. The render receipt returns deterministic full-data dataFacts; check prose against these facts, including endpoints, minimum, maximum and net change. Line/bar rows need explicit null for missing values. Time timestamps need offsets, timezone and granularity; duplicate instants need explicit upstream aggregation. Describe only the observed interval: do not invent irregular spacing, missing causes or trend forecasts. Histograms share increasing equal-width bin boundaries: [lower,upper), last bin includes upper. Unequal-width bins are unsupported; do not invent rebinning from pre-aggregated counts. Ratio denominator is valid observations in each group; missing is excluded. Weighted averages and quantiles are unsupported.
